title: SpecSync symlink cache key uses unresolved path
symptom: The archive cache identity names the PATH symlink instead of the exact resolved SpecSync executable.
trigger: Prime and reuse an archive entry through a symlinked SpecSync executable in a fixture.
expected: The cache key uses the resolved executable path and bytes supplied by the fixture.
actual: The key contains /Users/leif/.cargo/bin/specsync rather than the fixture's real-specsync path.
impact: A symlink target change could invalidate or reuse the wrong binary identity unless the resolved path is keyed.

notes.text: status: open -> verified. The resolved SpecSync executable path and bytes now pass the symlink regression after the preserved failure.
